profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA, that describes itself as a Work AI platform connected to enterprise data, offering search, content creation, and workflow automation. The platform is built around permission-aware retrieval and data access governance, and the company states it was designed for enterprise use from the beginning, with an emphasis on answers that are secure and explainable.

Glean's core product is an enterprise knowledge search and AI assistant that connects to company data through more than 100 connectors and supports the building of AI agents. The company cites deployments at Booking.com, where it describes being adopted company-wide as a first AI platform, at Ericsson for AI literacy and governed data access, at GCash for a searchable intranet and agent building in natural language, and at Zillow, which is quoted reporting an 80% adoption rate and describing the platform as helping a distributed workforce leverage data through current AI models.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server presence for Glean. The company's product is catalogued in the enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration category, consistent with its stated positioning around search, assistants, and agent orchestration across enterprise environments.
